summary: E2E testing of Pandurang Land Developers MVP. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass (enquiry create+persist with Marathi text, list newest-first, 422 validation for missing/empty/whitespace name/phone, default optional fields). Frontend: full flow via Playwright verified — Home hero Marathi headline, navbar links, WhatsApp floating button, Projects page with all 10 project cards, Project Detail page (badges N.A. PLOT + कर्ज उपलब्ध, feature list, Google map iframe, brochure .txt download, Enquire now→/contact), Contact form validation error toast on empty submit, successful enquiry submission with backend persistence verified via GET /api/enquiries (including Marathi project name), success state + reset flow, logo returns home. All critical paths green.

minor.issue: `logger` is defined at line 117 but used at line 92 inside create_enquiry. Works at runtime (function called after full module load) but violates ordering. Move logger init to top of file.

design_issues.screen: Navbar over Home hero (transparent state, before scroll)
issues: Nav links Projects/About us/Contact us use text-neutral-800 which becomes very low-contrast/nearly invisible against the dark aerial hero image; only Home (active gold) is readable. Consider text-white or a subtle gradient/background behind the nav when not scrolled.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Improve navbar link contrast in unscrolled (transparent) state on Home hero.
(Optional/minor) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above the route definitions in /app/backend/server.py for correctness/readability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logger defined after usage — works but should be moved up.
Contact.jsx: Marathi validation is client-side; server also validates 422 — good defense in depth.
server.py returns 200 on POST /api/enquiries (Not 201). Not strictly required but 201 would be more RESTful.
No pagination on /api/enquiries (to_list(1000)) — acceptable for MVP volume but should be paginated in future.
Contact form does not validate phone-number pattern (any string accepted). Consider a 10-digit regex or a maxLength.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed enquiries in MongoDB via POST /api/enquiries during backend + UI tests (safe to leave; identifiable by TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend enquiries API is fully working with Marathi UTF-8 preserved. Playwright reliably interacts with the shadcn Select using data-testid='enquiry-project' and option data-testid='enquiry-project-option-<slug>'. Brochure download works via page.expect_download(). All 10 project slugs render as project-card-<slug> on /projects. Contact success state uses data-testid='enquiry-success'.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only cosmetic design nit on navbar contrast over hero (documented above).
